assertions.assertion: Adds or references the Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration NuGet package
assertions.rationale: Correctly identifies and adds the Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration package via dotnet add package.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddIdentityServerConfiguration() on the service collection
Calls MapDynamicClientRegistration() to map the DCR endpoint
assertions.rationale: Maps the endpoint with app.MapDynamicClientRegistration() in the pipeline.

assertions.assertion: Notes that MapDynamicClientRegistration() is an endpoint-routing call from the Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration package, placed in the pipeline/endpoint routing (e.g. ConfigurePipeline) alongside UseIdentityServer()
assertions.rationale: Places the call in the pipeline but never notes that it is an endpoint-routing extension originating from the Configuration package.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that DCR requires Business Edition or higher license
assertions.rationale: Only vaguely refers to checking 'any licensing tier requirements'; does not state the Business Edition requirement.

assertions.assertion: The MapDynamicClientRegistration() call includes RequireAuthorization() or the response warns about securing the endpoint
assertions.rationale: Includes a security note warning to protect the endpoint and suggesting .RequireAuthorization().
